headline: Every box of chocolates checked, not a sample.
label: #F3E9DA
visitLine: Call and visit to your production site
heroLede: Koko Black makes its chocolates by hand in Melbourne, and in 2025 it agreed to take over a 5,812 square metre production facility in Heidelberg West. Handmade chocolate still ends up in boxes on a line, and every box needs the right label and date. This is what a camera check could look like on a chocolate packing line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every box has its lid on, closed square, with the seal or sleeve in place. A box that opens in transit is a gift that arrives looking wrong.
labelLede: A salted caramel box and a hazelnut box can look much the same at speed, and one of them carries tree nuts. The camera checks every box carries the right label for what is inside, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every box. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the range and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Foil pieces, ribbon offcuts and loose parts can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.

vocab.alert: Four crooked lids in fifteen minutes. Check the box closer.
